displayName: Baseline - Android Enterprise (Fully Managed) - Device Restrictions
description: Security hardening for Android Enterprise corporate-owned fully managed devices: blocks sideloading, developer options, USB file transfer and screen capture; enforces Play Protect, automatic app updates and lockout-to-wipe; and enables the boot-time network escape hatch so kiosk devices can recover after a managed network change. Disable the escape hatch only for higher-security/off-site fleets that have resilient managed connectivity and accept the recovery risk.
